purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Cancel Release details.
features: Cancel Release Function allows the user to cancel PR.
Booking Status should be Entered or Completed.
PR status should be Prepared or Supplied status.
If the PR has already been transferred to TOPS or the PR Key is linked with an Address, Cancel PR Release will not be allowed.

events.description: Opens the Cancel Release (PR Number) popup asking "Do you want to Cancel the PR request?" with a remark box
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Cancel Release from the single function menu

events.description: Cancels the PR and the Status changes to Cancelled. Message: "Port release cancelled successfully"
events.triggered_when: User enters a valid remark and clicks Ok

events.description: Closes the popup without cancelling the PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel on the popup

search.name: Remark
search.ui: Mandatory. The user types a valid remark for cancelling the PR
